product_one_liner.value: Advocate uses AI to structure commercial insurance policies, analyze coverage and compliance, and benchmark pricing for brokers, lenders, risk managers and property owners.

named_customers.notes: No two named customers could be verified in the company website, launch announcement or public review listings; references to agency programs and investors were not treated as customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 74 employees; the employee directory dates its approximately 74-person count to October 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index contains a funding/public-launch article, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists Platform Engineer, Product Engineer, Product Engineer (Europe, Remote), and Client Solutions Manager, InsurTech; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The security page names Anthropic and OpenAI for inference; the DPA additionally lists Perplexity as an artificial-intelligence subprocessor.

raised_18mo.notes: The $18 million seed announcement on August 4, 2026 falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title appears on the readable live board.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 4, 2026, Advocate publicly launched its standardized commercial-insurance pricing and coverage benchmarks, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page does not provide a complete named leadership roster or start dates, and no qualifying dated C-level or VP-level join/departure announcement could be verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable jobs refer generically to CRM platforms, integrations and internal tooling but do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
